title: StoBasket: Joint Upsell and Cross-Sell Optimization for Contribution Margin
abstract: arXiv:2610.22768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retail recommenders rank relevance, but retailers earn contribution margin: an upsell earns the margin difference over the item it replaces, whereas a cross-sell earns its full margin. We introduce joint stochastic basket editing, a formulation in which one policy selects replacement and addition offers for an existing basket, values them by expected incremental contribution margin, and couples them through displayed-offer, accepted-offer, and joint-acceptance response channels. To our knowledge, it is the first formulation in which upsell and cross-sell responses are coupled; prior separable treatments are its zero-coupling special case. In real-data-calibrated simulations on five public basket datasets, StoBasket captures essentially all attainable offer margin: within 0.5% in every default-price setting and within 0.7% when the true response lies outside its model family. Correct economic accounting is the broadest gain: margin-weight

translated_title: StoBasket：面向边际贡献的追加销售与交叉销售联合优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22768v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：零售推荐系统按相关性排序，但零售商赚取的是边际贡献：一次追加销售赚取的是其所替代商品之上的边际差额，而一次交叉销售赚取的是其全部边际。我们提出了“联合随机购物篮编辑”这一新的形式化框架：由单一策略为现有购物篮选择替换型与添加型优惠，以期望增量边际贡献对其进行估值，并通过展示优惠、接受优惠和联合接受三种响应渠道将其耦合起来。据我们所知，这是首个将追加销售与交叉销售响应相耦合的形式化方法，以往的可分离处理方法是其零耦合的特例。在基于真实数据校准、覆盖五个公开购物篮数据集的仿真中，StoBasket 几乎捕获了全部可获得的优惠边际：在每个默认价格设置下误差均在0.5%以内，当真实响应机制位于其模型族之外时也在0.7%以内。正确的经济核算是其最广泛的收益……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个将追加销售与交叉销售响应耦合的“联合随机购物篮编辑”框架StoBasket，以期望增量边际贡献为优化目标，在五个公开购物篮数据集的仿真中几乎捕获了全部可获得的优惠边际。
en_tdlr: StoBasket is the first formulation that jointly couples upsell and cross-sell responses via stochastic basket editing to maximize expected incremental contribution margin, capturing nearly all attainable offer margin in simulations on five public basket datasets.
